title: Rules for Settling the Deferred Balance under Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)
content:
# Settling the Deferred Balance — Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)

## Section 1. When the deferred balance is settled

1.1 Under the plan's settle-up rule, the deferred balance on Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) is settled on the anniversary bill (the bill of the plan's anniversary month), on the July bill for the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan, or never on a continuous rolling plan, whose deferred balance is spread through the installment instead.

1.2 The deferred balance is also settled on the exit bill where the plan requires settlement in full on exit or the plan is rolling, on the removal bill, and on the final bill where the plan settles on the final bill.

## Section 2. A balance owed (positive deferred balance)

2.1 A positive balance is made due on the settle-up bill, due the plan's settle-up due days after the bill date, unless the plan allows an anniversary debit to be spread and the member asks to spread an anniversary debit over the plan's spread bills.

2.2 Spreading applies to an anniversary debit only, and only at the member's request on a plan that allows it.

## Section 3. A credit (negative deferred balance)

3.1 A negative balance is released under the plan's credit handling: applied to the next bill, or refunded by check. Where checks apply, a credit is refunded by check only when it is at least the plan's smallest credit refunded by check.

## Section 4. Notice and the end of the plan

4.1 The member is notified the plan's anniversary notice days before an anniversary settle-up.

4.2 A plan ends once its exit, removal or final settle-up is booked.

## Settlement points at a glance

| Occasion | Is the deferred balance settled? |
|---|---|
| Anniversary bill, plans with an anniversary-month settle-up | Yes |
| July bill, Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | Yes |
| Any regular bill of a continuous rolling plan | No; the balance is spread through the installment |
| Exit bill | Yes, where settlement in full on exit is required or the plan is rolling |
| Removal bill | Yes |
| Final bill when service ends | Yes, where the plan settles on the final bill |

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- *Hypothetical:* on Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up the anniversary bill carries a deferred debit of $312.60. If the member asks to spread it, it is billed over 3 bills; if not, the whole $312.60 is due 20 days after the bill date.
- *Hypothetical:* on Small Business Budget Billing an anniversary deferred debit of $520.00 cannot be spread, because the plan does not allow it; it is due 20 days after the bill date.
- *Hypothetical:* on Budget Billing Quarterly Review the member exits with a deferred debit of $88.00. It is an exit debit, not an anniversary debit, so Section 2.2 does not allow it to be spread; it is due 20 days after the exit bill date.
- *Hypothetical:* on the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan the July bill shows a deferred credit of $72.10. It is at least $50.00, so it is refunded by check. A July credit of $31.00 is below $50.00, so it is not refunded by check.
- *Hypothetical:* on Levelized Billing Rolling Average there is no anniversary settle-up; a deferred debit of $64.00 at the member's exit is billed on the exit bill.
- *Hypothetical:* on Farm Budget Billing the anniversary bill carries a deferred credit of $140.00; it is applied to the next bill.
